Beak

“Beak” is a strong mix of Zone-made vodka and crushed black crow beaks. Only beaks from males that have lived in the Zone for over 15 years are suitable, as their beaks are more prone to mutation. Rumor says they are rich in protein which, together with vodka, removes radiation from the body. Some say the drink makes you feel wings growing for a few seconds. The taste is awful.\n
Strong Energy Drink (250 ml)

Stalkers often stock up on these before setting out on long trips. It has an invigorating effect and is very useful when tired. It also clears the head a little after a hangover and triggers an adrenaline rush. To avoid an overdose, don't overdo it.

Purified Water

Military canteens are meant for drinking water in small sips. This water was produced and purified by medics and scientists. First, it is boiled at very high temperatures with a special type of alcohol for purification and disinfection. Then it is cooled in refrigerators. The result is water completely free of radioactive contamination. If you still doubt its purity, you can add a couple of Aquatabs tablets. Because the production and purification process is complex, military canteens of water are available only in limited quantities and sold to stalkers at a moderate price. Medics also have some in stock, but theirs cost a little more because of delivery fees.

Altoids Mints

Very minty chewing candies imported from the West. They are refreshing, help clear radioactive particles from the mouth, and keep sleepiness at bay for a while. You chew ten at once only because any more would not fit in your mouth.

U.S. MRE

A ready-to-eat Meal, Ready-to-Eat (MRE): a self-contained individual U.S. military field ration for combat or other situations without nearby food. It is single-use. Its rugged packaging protects the contents in harsh conditions. Each pack contains an entrée and assorted foods and drinks. Though edible cold, it includes a flameless, water-activated exothermic heater that warms the meal and improves its taste.

Russian IRP-B Ration

Breakfast, lunch, and dinner in one pack, supplied in polymer boxes. Includes two servings of applesauce, four wipes, one yellowish apricot-flavored vitamin drink, two vitamin B tablets, four plastic spoons, four packs of ten cookies, three 20 g sugar packs, one can each of stewed meat, cheese, and fish, six match packs, canned vegetables, a salt pouch, three packs of black tea, and three food-heating tablets. The polymer case has three sections for breakfast, lunch, and dinner and protects against harmful substances.

Ukrainian Ration

A Ukrainian combat ration based on the Russian IRP-B, made only of commercially available canned and dried foods packed in thin plastic compartments. Contains two cans of porridge (buckwheat and buckwheat with beef), two cans of stewed meat, canned fish, six cookie packs, two jam packs, six candies, two tea packs, instant cherry drink powder, a chicken bouillon cube, and two sugar packs. Each pack includes a plastic spoon, a dry wipe, and a wet wipe.

Shabash's Tea

An elite hot tea made to Shabash's recipe and prized by veteran stalkers. It is based on green tea infused with dried orange pieces and jasmine blossoms, with a characteristic quinine bitterness. The drink warms you less than it invigorates, sharpening the senses and driving away sleep. Those who have drunk it on long trips to anomalies or during night ambushes know that its tart taste and citrus aroma are a sure sign that, despite everything, the job is in reliable hands. This is more than a drink: it is a ritual that helps you stay cool in the Zone's fiercest scrapes.

Canned Beef (Tushonka)

Tushonka is canned stewed meat produced in the Soviet Union and other Warsaw Pact countries. Ironically, the idea came to Russia as U.S. aid during World War II. Since then, it has been a staple for long-term meat storage among civilians and the military. Despite its long shelf life, its high fat content makes it nutritious, and it tastes reasonably good. The Chernobyl Exclusion Zone has seen many varieties. Since spring 2013, Abakan chopped meat has been the undisputed leader among canned foods.

Nemiroff Vodka
Putinka Vodka

Following Russia's strange tradition of naming vodka brands after the country's leader, Putinka first went into production after Vladimir Putin was elected president. It is made in Russia from the finest grain and crystal-clear Siberian spring water. Triple filtration, a smooth texture, a unique taste, and other qualities have earned it a reputation. Drink in moderation.

Nemiroff is a Ukrainian alcoholic beverage producer specializing mainly in vodka. It was founded in the city of Nemyriv, Vinnytsia Oblast. One of the best vodkas in the world—and in the Zone—but don't overdo it.
